96: WITH views AS (SELECT user_id, event_time as view_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_time) as rn FROM events WHERE event_type = 'VIEW'), carts AS (SELECT user_id, event_time as cart_time FROM events WHERE event_type = 'CART'), purchases AS (SELECT user_id, event_time as purchase_time FROM events WHERE event_type = 'PURCHASE') SELECT v.user_id, v.view_time, c.cart_time, p.purchase_time, CAST((julianday(p.purchase_time) - julianday(v.view_time)) * 24 * 60 AS INTEGER) as funnel_duration_minutes FROM views v JOIN carts c ON v.user_id = c.user_id AND c.cart_time > v.view_time JOIN purchases p ON v.user_id = p.user_id AND p.purchase_time > c.cart_time WHERE v.rn = 1 ORDER BY funnel_duration_minutes, v.user_id
